consequence.statement: Loki now enforces a maximum line size of 256KB by default; lines exceeding this size will be rejected unless the limit is explicitly disabled or increased in configuration.
consequence.remediation: If your environment processes lines larger than 256KB, you must explicitly set a higher max_line_size value or disable this enforcement in the Loki configuration.

assertion.statement: Loki 3.0.0 enforces a default maximum line size of 256KB, which can be disabled or increased via configuration.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for config-key default-changed
